questions.e: The Dow rose about 0.7% for the week, its second straight weekly gain, while the S&P 500 lost about 2% and the Nasdaq about 4.5%.
questions.q: For the week ending Friday, Oct 16, which major U.S. index finished with a weekly GAIN while the others fell?

questions.e: The Nasdaq dropped about 2.1% Friday, led by semiconductor and memory stocks, and lost about 4.5% for the week.
questions.h: A noticeable drop, but not a crash.
questions.q: Roughly how much did the Nasdaq Composite fall on Friday, Oct 16, as chip and AI stocks sold off?

questions.e: WTI jumped about 3.5% to roughly $101 a barrel as Middle East supply worries pushed energy prices higher; Brent finished near $110.
questions.q: Where did U.S. benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil end on Friday, Oct 16?

questions.e: The 10-year yield ended the day around 5.1%, up slightly on the day but lower for the week after spiking above 5.3% following Wednesday's hot CPI report.
questions.q: The 10-year Treasury yield, a key benchmark for mortgages and borrowing costs, hovered near what level on Friday, Oct 16?

questions.e: The FY2026 deficit was about $1.99 trillion, up from about $1.78 trillion a year earlier and the largest in five years, as spending and interest costs outpaced record revenue.
questions.h: Just shy of a round number of trillions.
questions.q: On Friday, Oct 16, the U.S. Treasury reported the federal budget deficit for fiscal year 2026 (ended Sept 30). Roughly how large was it?
